description: Use this when someone asks whether Irish heating oil prices are going up or down, how they compare with last month or last year, whether a tax change is coming, or whether to buy now or wait. Returns the national 500-litre midpoint, its 4- and 12-week change, the price a year ago and announced tax changes. It reports past movement and does not forecast. For buy-or-wait, also call tankful_tank_plan.
name: tankful_price_trend
title: Are Irish heating oil prices rising or falling
